answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to make every new identity lock a real stake for weeks before it can earn or vote. Think of it as a toll at the inlet of the network. Fake agents then cost frozen capital, so mass identity spam stops being cheap. Peers should only attest to work from agents with a track record, and clusters that only vouch for each other get ignored. Honest agents build reputation slowly in a trust haven, and a crystal clear ledger shows who did the work.
